title: migration.yaml
description: Describes one estate (a set of repositories migrated together) for migration-control.

project.description: Short name, used to name the agents, environment and memory store in your Anthropic workspace.

estate.description: Every module of the estate. They are analysed together, never in isolation.

name.description: Module id used in every report (e.g. billing-api).

description.description: One line: what this module is (helps the agent and the dashboard).

repo.description: HTTPS clone URL of a GitHub or GitLab repository.

provider.description: Defaults from the repo host; required for self-hosted GitLab.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA treated as 'what runs in production'.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding a token. Read access is enough to scan; publishing a PR/MR needs write access (GitHub: Contents + Pull requests; GitLab: api / write_repository).

path.description: Local directory or .tar.gz, uploaded as a snapshot.

depends_on.description: Modules this one calls or runs on (REST client, database, runtime host...).

base_branch.description: Branch pull/merge requests target (default: ref when it is a branch name). Required to publish when ref is a tag or a commit.

target.default: latest official stable version and latest security patch for every component
target.description: Free text: what 'up to date' means for this estate.

rules.description: Extra house rules, appended to the agents' instructions.

include_toolchain.description: Also report build/test toolchain components (scoped separately).

packages.description: Packages pre-installed in the cloud sandbox (cached across runs), e.g. {apt: [openjdk-17-jdk, maven]}.

model.description: 'auto' picks the newest Opus-class model, or give an exact model id.

budget_usd.description: Optional spend cap per run (list price).

type.description: local: Claude Code headless on this machine (your Claude subscription or API key). managed: Claude Managed Agents API (cloud sandbox, needs API credit).

isolation.description: local only. docker: one container per run (recommended — the agent runs builds and shell commands). none: directly on this machine.

image.description: local+docker only: base image (default node:22-bookworm). sandbox.packages are installed on top.
